      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti = null then (if application.income.grossMonthly = null or application.housing.principalInterest = null then null else if application.income.grossMonthly = 0 then null else (application.housing.principalInterest + (if application.housing.taxes = null then 0 else application.housing.taxes) + (if application.housing.insurance = null then 0 else application.housing.insurance) + (if application.housing.hoa = null then 0 else application.housing.hoa) + (if application.housing.mip = null then 0 else application.housing.mip) + (if application.debts = null then 0 else sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include = false or d.monthlyPayment = null then 0 else d.monthlyPayment))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100) else application.dti</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv = null then (if application.loan.amount = null or application.collateral.appraisedValue = null then null else if application.collateral.appraisedValue = 0 then null else if application.purpose = "purchase" and not(application.collateral.purchasePrice = null) then application.loan.amount / min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) * 100 else application.loan.amount / application.collateral.appraisedValue * 100) else application.ltv</text>

      </input>

testSuite.name: TC15_NoProduct_NullHorizonBlocksArm

testSuite.name: TC16_NoProduct_AllNullExceptId

cases.description: Fixed30 через явну фіксовану перевагу
Fixed30 через високу чутливість до ставки
ARM7/1: короткий горизонт + стабільний профіль

Конфлікт ARM7/1 vs Fixed (пріоритет → Fixed30)
Виконуються умови ARM7/1, але fixedPreference=true → очікувано: Fixed30

ManualReview через низький кредитний бал
Очікувано: ManualReview (бо creditScore < 640)

ManualReview через високий DTI
Очікувано: ManualReview (бо dti > 50)

ManualReview через високий LTV
Очікувано: ManualReview (бо ltv > 95)

Нейтральний сценарій (жодне правило не підходить)
Очікувано: null або дефолтне рішення (залежно від політики у DMN)
Фіксована перевага + кредитний бал 600 → відсічка переважає
Фіксована перевага + DTI 55 → відсічка переважає
Фіксована перевага + LTV 97 → відсічка переважає
Висока чутливість до ставки + кредитний бал 620 → відсічка переважає
Висока чутливість до ставки + DTI 60 → відсічка переважає
Висока чутливість до ставки + LTV 98 → відсічка переважає
Умови ARM7/1 виконані + DTI 51 → відсічка переважає (кейс зі смоук-прогону)
Умови ARM7/1 виконані + DTI 75 → відсічка переважає
Умови ARM7/1 + висока чутливість до ставки → Fixed30
Умови ARM7/1 + фіксована перевага і висока чутливість → Fixed30
Усі три відсічки одночасно → ManualReview
Кредитний бал рівно 640 → не відсічка (умова «нижче 640»)
Кредитний бал 639 → відсічка
DTI рівно 50 → не відсічка (умова «вище 50»)
DTI 50.5 → відсічка
LTV рівно 95 → не відсічка (умова «вище 95»)
LTV 95.1 → відсічка
Умови ARM, кредитний бал рівно 720 → ARM7/1 (умова «щонайменше 720»)
Умови ARM, кредитний бал 719 → жодне правило
Умови ARM, LTV рівно 80 → ARM7/1 (умова «80% або менше»)
Умови ARM, LTV 80.5 → жодне правило
Умови ARM, горизонт рівно 7 років → ARM7/1 (умова «сім років або менше»)
Умови ARM, горизонт 7.5 року → жодне правило
Умови ARM, горизонт 8 років → жодне правило
fixedPreference = null, решта нейтральна → жодне правило
Умови ARM, але creditScore = null → жодне правило (умова не виконана)
Фіксована перевага, DTI = null → Fixed30 (відсічка за DTI не спрацьовує)
Умови ARM, але incomeStability = null → жодне правило
rateSensitivity = null, фіксованої переваги немає → жодне правило
Кредитний бал 610 при rateSensitivity = null → ManualReview
Короткий горизонт і стабільний дохід, але LTV 85 → жодне правило
Умови ARM, але змінний дохід → жодне правило
Середня чутливість, без переваги, довгий горизонт → жодне правило
Висока чутливість до ставки, fixedPreference = null → Fixed30
Фіксована перевага, кредитний бал рівно 640 → Fixed30 (відсічки немає)
Базовий профіль ARM7/1 (горизонт 6, LTV 75, бал 740, DTI 30)
ARM7/1 з горизонтом 3 роки, бал 810, DTI рівно 50

testSuite.name: ManualReview_CreditBelow640
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640, so manual review applies even though fixed preference is set (rule 1 overrides rule 2).

testSuite.name: NoManualReview_CreditExactly640
testSuite.description: Credit score 640 is not below 640; no product rule matches because credit is under 720 and no fixed preference exists.

testSuite.name: Fixed30_DtiExactly50
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 does not trigger manual review; explicit fixed preference yields Fixed30.

testSuite.name: ManualReview_DtiAbove50
testSuite.description: DTI 50.1 exceeds 50, so manual review is required.

testSuite.name: NoManualReview_LtvExactly95_NoProduct
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 does not trigger manual review, but ARM requires LTV <= 80, so no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: ManualReview_LtvAbove95
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 exceeds 95, so manual review is required.

testSuite.name: Fixed30_FixedPreferenceWithMaxEligibility
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed preference with LTV 80 and credit 750 yields Fixed30.

testSuite.name: Fixed30_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity without explicit fixed preference yields Fixed30.

testSuite.name: ARM7_1_AllBoundariesInclusive
testSuite.description: Horizon 7 years, stable income, LTV 80 and credit 720 are all inclusive boundaries; no fixed preference, medium sensitivity yields ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: NoProduct_HorizonAboveSeven
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds 7, so ARM is not assigned and no other rule applies.

testSuite.name: NoProduct_VariableIncome
testSuite.description: Variable income fails the ARM stability condition; no fixed preference, so no product.

testSuite.name: NoProduct_LtvAbove80
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 fails the ARM LTV condition and is not above 95, so no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: NoProduct_CreditBelow720
testSuite.description: Credit 719 fails the ARM credit threshold; no fixed preference, so no product.

testSuite.name: ARM7_1_NullPreferenceFields
testSuite.description: Null fixedPreference and rateSensitivity are treated as unmet, so rule 3 applies and yields ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: Fixed30_NullDtiDoesNotTriggerManual
testSuite.description: Null DTI is treated as unmet for the manual review condition; fixed preference yields Fixed30.

testSuite.name: NoProduct_NullHorizon
testSuite.description: Null horizon makes the ARM horizon condition unmet; no fixed preference, so no product.

testSuite.name: NoProduct_NullCreditScore
testSuite.description: Null credit score makes the ARM credit condition unmet and does not trigger manual review; no product is assigned.

testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 does not trigger manual review; explicit fixed preference yields Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC03_Fixed30_DTI_Boundary_50
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 does not trigger manual review; fixed preference yields Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC04_ManualReview_DTI_Above_50
testSuite.description: DTI 50.1 exceeds 50, so manual review is required.

testSuite.name: TC05_Fixed30_LTV_Boundary_95_HighSensitivity
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 does not trigger manual review; high rate sensitivity yields Fixed30.

testSuite.description: LTV 95.1 exceeds 95, so manual review is required even with fixed preference.

testSuite.name: TC07_ManualReview_Overrides_FixedPreference_And_Sensitivity
testSuite.description: Low credit score combined with fixed preference and high sensitivity still yields ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC08_Fixed30_ExplicitFixedPreference
testSuite.description: Clean applicant with explicit fixed-rate preference receives Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC09_Fixed30_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity without fixed preference yields Fixed30 and overrides ARM eligibility.

testSuite.name: TC10_ARM71_AllBoundaries
testSuite.description: Horizon 7, stable income, LTV 80, credit score 720 satisfy all ARM boundary conditions inclusively.

testSuite.name: TC11_ARM71_Typical
testSuite.description: Typical applicant meets all ARM 7/1 criteria.

testSuite.name: TC12_NoProduct_HorizonAboveSeven

testSuite.name: TC13_NoProduct_LTVAbove80
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 exceeds 80, ARM not met, no fixed trigger, so no product.

testSuite.name: TC14_NoProduct_CreditScoreBelow720

testSuite.name: TC15_NoProduct_VariableIncome
testSuite.description: Variable income fails the ARM stability condition; no product.

testSuite.name: TC16_NoProduct_NullIncomeStability
testSuite.description: Null income stability makes the stability condition unmet; no product.

testSuite.name: TC17_NoProduct_NullCreditScore

testSuite.name: TC18_Fixed30_NullDtiAndLtv
testSuite.description: Null DTI and LTV make manual review conditions unmet; fixed preference yields Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC19_ARM71_NullPreferenceFields

testSuite.name: TC20_NoProduct_AllNull
testSuite.description: All decision inputs null; no rule applies, so no product.

testSuite.name: TC21_NoProduct_LowSensitivityLongHorizon

testSuite.name: TC22_NoProduct_NullHorizon

testSuite.name: TC01_LowCreditManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640, so manual review applies even though fixed rate is preferred (rule 1 has priority)

testSuite.name: TC02_CreditScoreBoundary640
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 does not trigger manual review; explicit fixed preference gives Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC03_DTIExactly50
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 does not trigger manual review; fixed preference gives Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC04_DTIAbove50ManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI 50.1 exceeds 50, so manual review applies

testSuite.name: TC05_LTVExactly95
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 does not trigger manual review; high rate sensitivity gives Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC06_LTVAbove95ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 exceeds 95, so manual review applies

testSuite.name: TC07_NullCreditScoreFixedPreference
testSuite.description: Null credit score makes manual review condition unmet; explicit fixed preference gives Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC08_ARMAllBoundaries
testSuite.description: Horizon 7, stable income, LTV 80, credit 720 satisfy all rule 3 boundaries; no fixed preference or high sensitivity

testSuite.name: TC09_ARMHorizonAboveSeven
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds seven years, so no product is assigned

testSuite.name: TC10_ARMCreditBelow720
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below 720 for ARM and not below 640, so no product is assigned

testSuite.name: TC11_ARMVariableIncome
testSuite.description: Variable income fails ARM stability condition, no product assigned

testSuite.name: TC12_ARMLTVAbove80
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 exceeds 80 for ARM, no product assigned

testSuite.name: TC13_ARMMediumSensitivity
testSuite.description: Medium rate sensitivity and no fixed preference allow ARM 7/1 when other conditions hold

testSuite.name: TC14_HighSensitivityNullFixedPreference
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity with null fixed preference gives Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC15_HighSensitivityNoFixedPreference
testSuite.description: Fixed preference false but high rate sensitivity gives Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC16_NullIncomeStabilityNoARM
testSuite.description: Null income stability makes ARM condition unmet, no product assigned

testSuite.name: TC17_CashOutLongHorizonNoProduct
testSuite.description: Refinance cash-out with horizon 10 years and no fixed preference or high sensitivity, no product assigned

testSuite.name: TC18_ARMZeroValuesMaxCredit
testSuite.description: Zero horizon, zero LTV and maximum credit score satisfy ARM 7/1 conditions

testSuite.name: TC19_LowCreditHighSensitivity
testSuite.description: Credit score 600 triggers manual review, overriding high rate sensitivity Fixed30 rule

testSuite.name: TC20_AllNullsNoProduct
testSuite.description: All decision inputs null, no rule condition is met, no product assigned

testSuite.name: TC21_NullLTVNoARM
testSuite.description: Null LTV makes ARM LTV condition unmet, no product assigned

testSuite.name: TC22_NullDTIDoesNotTriggerManual
testSuite.description: Null DTI makes manual review DTI condition unmet; fixed preference gives Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC23_LowCreditAndHighLTVManual
testSuite.description: Both low credit and LTV above 95 trigger manual review

testSuite.name: TC01_CreditScore_639_ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640, so manual review applies

testSuite.name: TC02_CreditScore_640_NoProduct
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 does not trigger manual review; ARM requires 720, so no product

testSuite.name: TC03_DTI_Exactly50_ARM
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 does not trigger manual review; all ARM conditions met including LTV 80 and credit 720 boundaries

testSuite.name: TC04_DTI_Above50_ManualReview_OverridesFixed
testSuite.description: DTI above 50 triggers manual review, which overrides explicit fixed rate preference

testSuite.name: TC05_LTV_Exactly95_FixedPreference
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 does not trigger manual review; fixed preference yields Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC06_LTV_Above95_ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV above 95 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC07_FixedPreference_True_Fixed30
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed rate preference with no manual review triggers yields Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC08_RateSensitivity_High_Fixed30
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity yields Fixed30 even without fixed preference

testSuite.name: TC09_ARM_InclusiveBoundaries
testSuite.description: Horizon 7, LTV 80, credit 720, stable income, medium sensitivity yields ARM7/1 at inclusive boundaries

testSuite.name: TC10_HorizonAbove7_NoProduct
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years fails ARM condition; rate sensitivity low and no fixed preference, so no product

testSuite.name: TC11_VariableIncome_NoProduct
testSuite.description: Variable income fails ARM condition; no fixed preference, so no product

testSuite.name: TC12_LTV_Above80_NoARM
testSuite.description: LTV 80.5 fails ARM condition (max 80); no product

testSuite.name: TC13_CreditScore_719_NoARM
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 fails ARM condition (min 720); no product

testSuite.name: TC14_CreditScore_Null_FixedPreference
testSuite.description: Null credit score makes manual review condition unmet; fixed preference yields Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC15_CreditScore_Null_ARMConditionUnmet
testSuite.description: Null credit score makes ARM condition unmet; all other ARM conditions satisfied, so no product

testSuite.name: TC16_AllRelevantNull_NoProduct
testSuite.description: Null values for all decision inputs; no condition is met, so no product

testSuite.name: TC17_BoundaryMinimums_ARM
testSuite.description: Maximum credit score, zero horizon and zero LTV with stable income yields ARM7/1

testSuite.name: TC18_CashOut_LowCredit_ManualReview
testSuite.description: Cash-out refinance with credit score 600 and high rate sensitivity triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC19_HighRateSensitivity_HighDTI_ManualReview
testSuite.description: High DTI above 50 triggers manual review, overriding high rate sensitivity

testSuite.name: TC20_RateSensitivityMedium_NoFixed_NoProduct
testSuite.description: Medium rate sensitivity and no fixed preference do not trigger Fixed30; ARM fails on horizon 10, so no product
